rank_transform: Phi^-1((average_rank-0.5)/n), followed by population standardization; continuous columns only; training subset only
interpretation: Exact-reference replay is exploratory and all ten historical graphs are retained. Fresh Gaussian and Student-t mechanisms use an independent seed; each has its paired monotone measurement transform. Rank-mode equality across that transform is algebraic, not independent evidence of recovery. Native and rank-native use the same priors, all parent families, SMC budget and paired random seeds. All failures remain reported. Eight seeds are a bounded reproducibility pilot, not a claim of universal stability.
